title: Pull action items out of meeting notes
summary: Read short meeting notes and return the real action items as JSON, with each owner and a due date worked out from phrases like 'by Friday'.
instructions:
Read the meeting notes below and return the action items as a JSON object with the fields meeting_date (YYYY-MM-DD), action_count (a whole number) and actions. Each entry of actions has owner, task and due, in the order they appear in the notes.

What counts as an action item: a sentence where a named person commits to do something, such as '<Name> to <do something>' or '<Name> will <do something>'. These are not action items: decisions, general remarks, 'we should ...' with no named person, and anything only floated as a possibility ('may', 'might', 'no commitment yet').

Owner: the first name of the person who does the work. If the notes say the work was handed to someone else, use the new person.
Task: a short description in your own words. It is not checked word for word.
Due: a date as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if the notes give no deadline. Work dates out from the meeting date with these rules:
- 'by <weekday>': the first such weekday after the meeting day. If the meeting is on a Wednesday, 'by Wednesday' means the following Wednesday.
- 'next <weekday>': that weekday in the week after the week of the meeting (weeks run Monday to Sunday).
- 'by tomorrow': the day after the meeting.
- 'by the end of the month': the last day of the month the meeting is in.
- 'by <day> <month>': that date in the year of the meeting.

Reply with the JSON object only: no code fences, no explanation before or after it.

How it is checked: your JSON must fit the published schema. Then each important value in it is compared with a hidden answer key. The score is the share of values that match, and the reward is paid only for a score of 100.

-----BEGIN DATA-----

- Chidi to send the revised budget to finance by Friday.

- Ada will fix the failing payment webhook by tomorrow.
- We should revisit pricing next quarter.
- Femi to share the interview recordings with the team.
- Chidi to book the customer call next Tuesday.
- Tobi to update the onboarding guide by the end of the month.
- Kemi will send the design files to the printer by Wednesday.
